title: Latent preview decoders - ship the weights we enable, and evaluate taehv for LTX
description:
Seen on every generation during the macOS 1.3.0 run 2026-07-31: `Warning: TAESD previews enabled, but could not find models/vae_approx/taesdxl_decoder`. We switch TAESD on twice - `--preview-method taesd` at routes/comfy.js:390, and Comfy.Execution.PreviewMethod / Comfy.PreviewMethod at routes/engine.js:527-528 - but no taesd or vae_approx entry exists anywhere in js/data/modelConstants/, and models/vae_approx/ does not exist on disk. CONSEQUENCE: no live preview image while sampling; the user watches a progress bar with no picture. Cause is platform-independent - it is a missing dependency, not a macOS issue - but local-engine generation has rarely been exercised (the Windows SAC laptop had no GPU and skipped its smoke, the dev PC's smoke ran remote on a Pod, and the Linux box cannot boot ComfyUI at all), which is plausibly why it has gone unnoticed. Decide between shipping the decoder as a universal engine asset or turning taesd off; do not leave a feature switched on whose inputs we never install. Evidence: tasks/MPI-370/validation.md section 'TWO NEW DEFECTS FOUND AT FIRST BOOT'.

MERGED 2026-08-01: this card absorbs MPI-294 (Better LTX live preview via taehv taeltx2_3 decoder).
- MPI-294 - madebyollin/taehv now ships taeltx_2 / taeltx2_3 / taeltx2_3_wide dedicated LTX-2.3 tiny decoders; current LTX previews are poor.
WHY ONE CARD: Same subsystem and the same missing table: we switch TAESD previews on in two places and no taesd / vae_approx entry exists anywhere in js/data/modelConstants/. Adding the vae_approx dep family is the work, and the LTX decoder is another file in that same family - one dep-table pass, one download-manager check, both engines.
The absorbed card(s) are closed as done/rejected - not built, kept as the record - and their full original text stays on disk at tasks/<id>/.
